## Presentations

This page will be updated with selected talks, posters, workshops, and conference presentations.

## Selected Research Presentations

- **Adaptive Kernel Methods for Operator Learning**  
  Research direction on combining kernel approximation ideas with neural operator architectures.

- **Barycentric DeepONets for Scientific Machine Learning**  
  Work on barycentric formulations of DeepONets for learning solution operators.

- **Fourier Neural Operators for PDE Learning**  
  Research on Fourier-based neural operator models for learning mappings between function spaces.

## Posters

- **Nurse-led, culturally grounded PTSD stigma reduction in Ghana using Adinkra symbols**  
  Poster project on culturally responsive mental health education and PTSD stigma reduction.
